# Wegoo AI

Wegoo AI is a developer-focused AI Gateway for GPT/Codex, Claude, Gemini, and image-generation models. One API key can be used across supported model families through OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints.

## Core Positioning

- Transparent forwarding: model requests are routed to the configured upstream without hidden prompt injection or silent model replacement.
- Multi-model access: developers can manage API keys, model groups, usage records, wallet balance, invoices, tickets, and service status in one console.
- Auditable billing: usage logs expose model, token, cache, latency, and cost metadata so users can understand each charge.
- Balance clarity: paid recharge, card-code recharge, manual collection, refunds, gift compensation, referral rewards, and invoiceable balance are classified separately.

## Public Pages

- Home: https://ai.wegoo.site/home
- Models and pricing: https://ai.wegoo.site/pricing
- API docs: https://ai.wegoo.site/docs
- Service status: https://ai.wegoo.site/status
- Enterprise, invoices, and manual collection: https://ai.wegoo.site/enterprise
- API key usage lookup: https://ai.wegoo.site/key-usage

## Public Fact Sources

- Public model pricing: https://ai.wegoo.site/api/v1/public/model-pricing
- Public model groups compatibility endpoint: https://ai.wegoo.site/api/v1/public/channels/available
- Public service monitors: https://ai.wegoo.site/api/v1/public/channel-monitors
- Public sitemap: https://ai.wegoo.site/sitemap.xml
- Public update feed: https://ai.wegoo.site/feed.xml

Public model and status pages should be treated as the source of truth for unauthenticated visitors. Logged-in users may see additional private groups, exclusive groups, subscriptions, user-specific discounts, and account-level details in the console.

## Integration

Use an API key created in the Wegoo AI console and replace the SDK base URL with the Wegoo AI endpoint shown in the dashboard or docs page.

OpenAI-compatible clients can use the `/v1` endpoint. Anthropic-compatible clients can use the Anthropic-compatible gateway endpoint when enabled for the selected group. Codex CLI and Claude Code users should follow the current console/docs instructions because group permissions and model support are configured by the platform.

## Billing And Invoices

Invoiceable sources include normal user recharge, card-code recharge, and administrator-confirmed manual collection when classified as paid recharge. Gift compensation, referral rewards, and non-payment balance adjustments are not invoiceable. Refunds reduce the corresponding net recharge amount.

## Support

Use the ticket system in the console for account, billing, invoice, request-log, and model-status issues. Enterprise users can use the enterprise page to request manual collection, invoice coordination, and dedicated support.
